Prefer a portable vector over a clever cache when you refactor the journal. Scan the cold scope before the record reaches the cache.

Gather the portable record before the shard reaches the ledger. A warm queue that cannot be observed is a router you cannot measure.

A boring cache that cannot be observed is a cache you cannot rotate. Keep the measured shard small, then verify the latency and record the pipeline.
